stories.title: Hong Kong jewellery shop slapped with 30-day tour group ban over coerced sales
stories.summary: Hong Kong’s tourism watchdog has suspended a jewellery shop from receiving tour groups for 30 days after finding it failed to stop a guide from coercing mainland Chinese visitors into making purchases.
